The University of Guelph guarantees President's International Entrance Scholarships to international fee-paying students entering a first undergraduate degree. The amount depends on your admission average: CA$10,000–20,000 in year 1 and CA$7,500 in each of years 2–4, for a total of CA$32,500–42,500.

It is worth CA$42,500 over the degree and includes guaranteed on-campus residence with first-choice room preference in first year. Two awards are made each year, based on academic excellence and contributions to school and community.

Guelph, in Ontario, is known for agriculture, veterinary medicine, life sciences and environmental science. Separately, all international applicants are automatically considered for guaranteed President's International Entrance Scholarships (CA$32,500–42,500 over four years), so applying for the Vaccarino award is an extra chance at the top tier.
